scope: In-memory Python SQLite with minimal columns preserving reviewed primary-key, foreign-key cascade and DAO predicate semantics. Not Android Room generated SQL execution or a full schema migration test.
findings: Reader query finds no summary written with SUMMARY_UNSCANNABLE, while the ordinary-group query includes it because it excludes UNSCANNABLE_SUMMARY. Both actual source predicates reproduced.

INSERT OR REPLACE of a SCOPED group with the same signature removes the prior FULL row and cascades deletion of its two member refs. Actual Room-generated insert has not been inspected; SQL control matches declared REPLACE strategy.
Replacing the global summary key for SCOPED removes the FULL summary too. Six assertions passed in SQLite 3.54.1.
